div.head: I Cn 13
div.ab: And sawlsceat is rihtast, þæt man symle gelæste á æt openum græfe.
And saulsceat is rihtast, þæt man symle geleste á æt openum græfe.
Pecunia sepulturę iustum est, ut aperta terra reddatur.
And sawlsceat is rihtast þæt man symle gelæste á æt openum græfe.
And sawlsceat is rihtast þæt man symle gelæste a æt openum græfe.
Und Seelengeld ist am richtigsten, dass man immer sofort entrichte beim offenen Grabe.
And as for soul-scot, it is most right that it always be paid at once at the open grave.
And it is best that payment for the souls of the dead should always be rendered before the grave is closed.
And it is most appropriate that dues for the souls of the dead always be paid while the grave is yet open.
